name: manuscript_tables_and_figure_data
description: Compose the tables and the figure data of the Results section from checksum-verified stage outputs, so every number in the draft can be traced to the measurement that produced it.

frozen_frame.rule: the frame was fixed before the sweep numbers were interpreted; a table added afterwards must be marked as added and carry the reason

sources.verification: every source is verified against the checksum its stage manifest records, through data/manifests
sources.no_manual_numbers: a composed table may only contain values read from a verified source, never a value typed in by hand

figures.format: tidy data, one row per series point; no image is rendered because the frozen stack carries no plotting library
figures.uncertainty: every point that has repetitions carries the minimum and the maximum next to the median
figures.caption_requirement: every figure caption must name the declared 2 vCPU environment and the claim limit

environment_note: Seluruh angka waktu berasal dari satu node dengan 2 vCPU yang dibekukan sebagai batas sumber daya; angka tersebut hanya dapat dibaca sebagai perbandingan antarperlakuan pada perangkat keras yang sama.
invariants: every composed table names the sources it was built from
every source is verified against its stage manifest before a value is read
every table and figure of the frozen frame is accounted for, either composed, copied or explicitly deferred with a reason
a table added after the frame was frozen is marked as added and carries its reason
every figure series that has repetitions carries its minimum and maximum
no value is written that does not appear in a verified source
